scope: An actual excluded-boundary witness, not a counterexample to the qualified Balasubramanian–Koblitz theorem. See research/theorem_census_20261109/PRIMARY_AUDIT.md. Signed standing pending.
statement: A nonsingular F7 curve has 3 dividing q-1 and 3^2 dividing its rational point count, yet has a geometric 3-torsion point outside the rational-point image.
